Assessment of BA.evidence_source: To examine the factor structure of Malay BAS-2 scores, we used a two-step, EFAto-CFA analytic strategy, as recommended by Swami and Barron (2018) for the test adaptation of body image instruments. Our plan was to examine fit of the one-factor model of BAS-2 scores, as well as any factor structure identified by the EFAs, if different.

section_summary.extract_value: This section details the analytic strategy for a study, including handling missing data and performing exploratory factor analysis (EFA) and confirmatory factor analysis (CFA).
